items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Schiffer. (Context: Interviewee Charles Mingus is asked about a piano player used to be with Dizzy Gillespie, identified as Lalo Schifrin, but Mingus does not speak or confirm a personal relationship in the provided text.)

ctx.x: What's this piano player used to be with Dizzy Gillespie? That makes a lot of movies now.
